It's based on the Triton fork
Is there a hardware-based limitation that makes this only supported on MI200 series GPUs instead of also RX 6000 and RX 7000 series GPUs? If not, why is it only supported on MI200 series GPUs?

> Is there a hardware-based limitation that makes this only supported on MI200 series GPUs instead of also RX 6000 and RX 7000 series GPUs? If not, why is it only supported on MI200 series GPUs?

This is due to both infra support and compiler limit.
1. The current triton-mathaot doesn't select compiled kernels according to arch, we are working on a separate repository (to be released soon) to support this.
2. The Triton compiler only has experimental support on non-MI200 GPUs. We are working on this, and more arches will be added later.
3. Theoretically this approach works for any Triton platforms, but corresponding code is needed.
